title: Probabilistic early-warning metering signal for Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Short summary: Implement a low-latency, probabilistic metering signal that surfaces likely anomalous or spike usage for the Console early-warning pipeline. Goals: provide 95% recall for >3x baseline token bursts within 30s, under 5% false positive rate; produce signals at tenant/model/route granularity; integrate with Console alerts and dashboards; ensure deterministic reconciliation with authoritative billing ledger during nightly batch.

Technical approach: instrument a streaming aggregator in the ingestion path that maintains time-decayed HyperLogLog and Count-Min sketches plus a small reservoir sampler per tenant-route. Produce per-window confidence intervals and an urgency score. Emit candidate signals to a Kafka topic 'metering.alerts.probabilistic' consumed by Console alarm service. Provide a slowpath reconciliation job that replays exact token counts from ledger events and flags mismatches for automatic credits or manual review.

Trade-offs: probabilistic structures reduce memory and CPU for hot tenants but introduce tunable error; we'll tune windows and thresholds to prioritize recall for billing-critical spikes. We'll keep the authoritative ledger unchanged and only surface signals — final billing still relies on deterministic reconciler.

Acceptance criteria: end-to-end signal ingestion to Console alarm with synthetic load tests showing >95% detection and <5% FP at target thresholds; dashboards showing per-tenant latency and confidence; nightly reconciliation job corrects any drift and generates audit logs.
comments: 2025-11-04 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting with Console PM (Jing Li) and Infra lead (Diego). Agreed scope: signal only, no billing enforcement initially. Action: prototype sketches and sampling thresholds.

2025-11-06 - Diego Morales: Spike prototype using Count-Min + reservoir sampler working on dev cluster. Memory footprint for top 10k tenants ~120MB. Observed 2.8s median processing latency for ingestion path, need optimization to meet 500ms for hot paths.

2025-11-07 - Engineering review: Consider moving sketch aggregation into a shard-local aggregator service to avoid adding latency on request path. Trade-off: extra replica/service to manage, but reduces tail latency.

2025-11-09 - PM (Jing Li): Console UX mockups linked: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Console/Probabilistic+Metering+Signals. Need fields: tenant, model, route, window, confidence, urgency score, evidence sample link.

2025-11-10 - Diego Morales: Created PR for Kafka topic and schema (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2719). Asking infra to provision retention and partitioning with 12 partitions for expected throughput.
2025-11-11 - Load testing: synthetic burst tests (10k tps per partition) show recall 96.4% and FP 4.7% on current thresholds. Next: implement shard-local aggregators and re-run to hit latency target.

2025-11-12 - Next steps: (1) Implement shard-local aggregator as sidecar (ENG-861531 planned), (2) Add reconciliation job to nightly ledger replay and automated correction task (ENG-861532), (3) Add Console alert mapping and runbook for incidents.
